root_cause.text: The `vidtv_ts_null_write_into()` and `vidtv_ts_pcr_write_into()` functions in the vidtv driver accept their argument structs (`struct null_packet_write_args` and `struct pcr_write_args`) by value, which triggers MSAN uninitialized-value warnings during the stack copy of the structs.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff modifies the signatures of `vidtv_ts_null_write_into()` and `vidtv_ts_pcr_write_into()` in `drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_ts.c` and `vidtv_ts.h` to accept const pointers instead of passing the structs by value, and updates the callers in `vidtv_mux.c` to pass the addresses of the structs.
